says: In today's CI, legs.ts sizes a pull request's next and e2e legs with `measured` (size's default table), while those legs run at FABRIKA_TEST_DEPTH full, where Shards splits by rowsAt("full"); its header says 'this split is the one Shards makes on each leg', which holds only for files with no full row.
proof: check.yaml lines 465 and 483 set FABRIKA_TEST_DEPTH: full on the next and e2e steps; legs.ts line 270 calls size(run, selected, full, limit) with no table; vitest.shards.full.json holds 330 next/ rows, many unlike their measured rows.
cost: A sized pull request can get fewer legs than its full-depth seconds need, and a leg can run past the budget it was sized for.
